ocl:
context AlertRule
inv: (self.ruleId <> '') and (self.alerts->forAll(v | v.acknowledged = true))

context Gateway
inv: (self.isPrimary = true) and (self.connectedEdges->forAll(v | v.memoryMB < 1000))

context Alert
inv: self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null

context Location
inv: (self.device.firmware.checksum <> '') and (self.longitude >= 7 and self.longitude <= 41)

context CommunicationLink
inv: self.isSecure implies self.stream <> null

context MaintenanceTicket
inv: (self.otaUpdate.targetDevice = self.device) and (self.status <> '' and self.status.size() > 0)

context DataStream
inv: (self.records->any(x | x.timestamp <> '') <> null) and (self.streamId <> '' and self.streamId.size() > 0)

context AlertRule
inv: self.alerts->exists(x | x.acknowledged <> false)

context Battery
inv: self.healthPct >= 1 and self.healthPct <= 80

context SolarPanel
inv: self.wattPeak >= 26 and self.wattPeak <= 51

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 13 and self.maxLoad <= 54

context ActuatorNode
inv: self.maxLoad >= 7 and self.maxLoad <= 50

context SensorNode
inv: (self.sampleRateHz mod 5 = 0) and (self.sensorType <> '' and self.sensorType.size() > 0)

context CommunicationLink
inv: self.bandwidthKbps >= 42 and self.bandwidthKbps <= 64

context SensorNode
inv: (self.metrics->collect(x | x.lastValue)->sum() >= 9) and (self.metrics->one(x | x.lastValue >= 10))

context Cluster
inv: (self.edgeNodes->any(x | x.cpuCores > 1) <> null) and (self.clusterId.size() >= 13)

context Alert
inv: ((self.acknowledged = true) and (self.assignedTo <> null)) and (not((self.acknowledged = true) and (self.assignedTo <> null)))

context Cluster
inv: ((self.gateways->size() > 0) and (self.gateways->collect(x | x.ipAddress)->notEmpty())) and (self.gateways->size() < -5)

context DataStream
inv: (self.alertRules->collect(x | x.alerts)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.alertRules->collect(x | x.alerts)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.policyId <> '') and (self.roles->forAll(v | v.roleName <> ''))) and (self.roles->exists(v | not(v.roleName <> '')))

context CommunicationLink
inv: (self.bandwidthKbps mod 2 = 0) and (not(self.bandwidthKbps mod 2 = 0))

context SensorNode
inv: (self.metrics->select(x | x.lastValue <= 50)->size() >= 1) and (not(self.metrics->select(x | x.lastValue <= 50)->size() >= 1))

context Alert
inv: ((self.acknowledged = true) and (self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null)) and (not((self.acknowledged = true) and (self.acknowledged implies self.assignedTo <> null)))

context Firmware
inv: (self.devices->forAll(x | x.deviceId <> '')) and (self.devices->exists(x | not(x.deviceId <> '')))

context Device
inv: ((self.deviceId <> '') and (self.tickets->forAll(v | v.ticketId <> ''))) and (self.tickets->exists(v | not(v.ticketId <> '')))

context AccessPolicy
inv: ((self.roles->one(x | x.roleName <> '')) and (self.policyId.size() >= 16)) and (not((self.roles->one(x | x.roleName <> '')) and (self.policyId.size() >= 16)))

context DataStream
inv: ((self.topic <> '') and (self.records->forAll(v | v.timestamp <> ''))) and (self.records->exists(v | not(v.timestamp <> '')))

context IoTPlatform
inv: (self.accessPolicies->exists(x | x.policyId <> '')) and (not(self.accessPolicies->exists(x | x.policyId <> '')))

context DataStream
inv: (self.link <> null) and (not(self.link <> null))

context Cluster
inv: ((self.gateways->collect(x | x.connectedEdges)->size() >= 3) and (self.gateways->size() >= 1)) and (self.gateways->size() < 1)
